rows.name: Root (base game)
rows.contents: The Marquise de Cat, Eyrie Dynasties and Woodland Alliance, and the Vagabond as Thief, Tinker or Ranger; the Autumn map and the free Winter map; the standard 54-card deck with dominance and ambush cards; coalitions; the built-in Dire Wolf AI for every base faction. It holds everything the six first-version characters need: Gustave, Esquie, the Paintress, Sciel, Verso and Maelle.
rows._notes: The Clockwork Expansion has no row: E33 mode hides the Clockwork bots, so the mod never depends on it.

rows.name: The Riverfolk Expansion
rows.contents: The Riverfolk Company and the Lizard Cult; the Vagrant, Scoundrel and Arbiter Vagabonds; a second Vagabond seat; 6 challenges and AI improvements (digital release April 28 2021). Root 33 uses it for Clea (Lizard Cult) and for the second Vagabond seat that a table with two of Esquie, Verso and Maelle needs. The Riverfolk Company stays free for a later Golgra or Gestral character.

_unverified.steamAppId: not found in research; confirm in Root's code on the creator's PC (or on the DLC's Steam store page)

rows.name: The Underworld Expansion
rows.contents: The Underground Duchy and the Corvid Conspiracy; the Lake and Mountain maps; Advanced Setup; challenges (digital release March 30 2023). Root 33 uses it for the Curator (Duchy) and the White-Haired Man (Corvids); Lake and Mountain work too, because map roles are assigned by rule.

_unverified.steamAppId: not found in research; confirm in Root's code on the creator's PC (or on the DLC's Steam store page)

rows.name: The Marauder Expansion
rows.contents: Lord of the Hundreds and Keepers in Iron, with tutorials, challenges and achievements (digital release January 14 2025; hirelings came later in their own DLC). Root 33 uses it for Monoco (Hundreds) and Lune (Keepers).

_unverified.steamAppId: not found in research; confirm in Root's code on the creator's PC (or on the DLC's Steam store page)

rows.name: Exiles & Partisans & Vagabonds
rows.contents: The Exiles and Partisans deck and the Adventurer, Ronin and Harrier Vagabonds (digital release May 3 2022). Root 33 uses it only as an option: Maelle may ride the Ronin instead of the Thief, with Swift Strike as her riposte.

rows.name: Hirelings & Landmarks
rows.contents: 13 hireling pairs (each with a promoted and a demoted form; three join a game) and the landmarks Black Market, Lost City, Legendary Forge, Elder Treetop, Ferry and Tower, plus rules-fidelity and AI updates (digital release October 20 2025). Root 33 uses it only for the v1.1 theming of hirelings and landmarks.
